title: Ionized neon made by hand docked at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) from neon bought there, kept in storage (not sold)
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: the traders left at the capitals after the once lines take standing work there, docked NPC-facility crafting; rules F8, F23, O1 zero empty burn). 34 traders wait docked at the Crimson War Citadel after Krynn's once lines (fill.py status trader 18:25 UTC: 64 trader waiting). The Citadel's book (table books, 18:43 UTC): neon_gas asked at 1 cr, ionized_neon bid at 1 cr x 880 (the station's). ionize_neon_gas by hand: 6 neon_gas -> 3 ionized_neon a run; a run costs about 6.1 cr and sells for 3 cr while the bid holds: crafting XP for about 3.1 cr a run, no fuel, no jump. requires.docked_at keeps it to a ship already docked there (no trip). No requires.bid: what the bid does not take is stored, so the route stays open when the 1 cr bid is drained; ionized_neon is no reserve good (game/reserve.tsv, needs.tsv). standing: XP work, never judged on its pay. Three crafts beside it (argon, neon, oxygen) split the 34 ships over three bids. 2026-11-23 19:07 UTC (Mercury): the third craft stop keeps the ship docked on desk watch for 20 minutes (watch_minutes, 0 fuel): a run of 24 to 36 crafts costs about 74 to 122 cr once the 1 cr bids are drained, so the watch halves the burn of the standing crafts while every ship stays at work (orders ENT-083 block MERCURY, P1 pay for itself); measured in flight (F37) and tuned next turn. 2026-11-23 19:10 UTC (Mercury): reservecheck.py --plan trader FLAGged the sale (rule F24): it holds ionized neon back for synthesize_neon_power_cell (3,513 held, surplus 0). The sale is taken out: what is made is stored, nothing sold; ionized neon is no good of the pull record (data/routes/pull.json), so no full mark closes it. 2026-11-23 19:29 UTC (Mercury): the 20-minute watch is out again: route_run.py's desk watch calls save_book and save_board, which no line defines, so every run with watch_minutes crashed at its first poll (NameError, line 947; runs.jsonl 19:10 UTC). The fix (fleet-build copy, test red then green) waits for a clean clone (queue.log).
